example_expansion_rule: For each parcel in listed order create all 10 scenario templates in listed order; assign IDs sequentially HD2-QA-340..HD2-QA-369. Every example is non-business QA and preserves the recorded numeric measurements unchanged.
common_fail_closed_rules: Survey/capture programme is not a substitute for survey-index lineage.
WMS preview/coverage footprint cannot be queried as numeric elevation.
Title-plan red edging/general boundary is not an exact legal boundary.
Resolution, coordinate rounding and encoding precision do not imply accuracy.
OS Terrain 5 contours/spot heights remain secondary to the primary EA DTM raster sample.
Deprecated WCS interpolation semantics are version-lineage evidence and cannot override current service behavior.
Missing parcel-specific survey-index evidence remains explicitly unknown rather than inferred.
